versions.startupSource:
10 CLS
15 DIM X(1),Y(1),XD(1)
20 LINE(0,47)-(127,5),SET,BF
30 'FORI=1TO20:Y=RND(46):LINE(0,Y)-(127,Y),SET:NEXTI
40 X(0)=30:X(1)=97:XD(1)=-1:XD(0)=1
50 FOR P=0TO1:SET(X(P),0):NEXTP:P=1
90 P=1-P:IF NOTPOINT(X(P),Y(P)) THEN 500 ELSECM=PEEK(14400):NX=X(P)+XD(P):NY=Y(P)+1:IFNY>47THENNY=0
100 IFNX>127THENNX=0ELSEIFNX<0THENNX=127
105 PT=POINT(X(P),NY):IFPTHENIF8ANDCMTHENPT=-1ELSEIF16ANDCMTHENPT=0ELSE ELSEIF1ANDCMTHENPT=-1ELSEIF2ANDCMTHENPT=0
110 RESET(X(P),Y(P)):IFPTTHENSET(NX,Y(P)):SET(X(P),NY):X(P)=NX ELSESET(X(P),NY):Y(P)=NY:GOTO130
115 IF PEEK(14337)AND2THENXD(1)=-XD(1)
116 IF CM AND 96 THEN XD(0)=-XD(0)
